recipes.label: Goal: Paddock Bunker
recipes.startdescription: The city above has become a hell woven of ash and sulfur, but down here, deep underground, the air remains cool and damp, carrying the familiar scent of mold. Let us settle this quietly and leave as swiftly as possible.

recipes.label: Retrieval Completed
recipes.startdescription: The interior of the facility remains completely unscathed — well worth the immense effort I poured into building it and the care with which I just opened it myself. Deeper inside, my masterpiece also remains perfectly intact, waiting quietly for my retrieval.

recipes.label: Goal: The Black Bazaar
recipes.startdescription: Now, I'm starting to understand why the damned Suppression Bureau has been unable to clean up this city. The participants here likely outnumber the Bureau's own personnel—but no matter how many bidders there are, I'll be the winner tonight.

recipes.label: The Real Book of Prophecy?
recipes.startdescription: The moment I opened it, I understood—they could only glimpse fragments of words because those words were not meant for them. Now, before me, lines of shimmering text emerge clearly, their meaning unmistakable, shifting with every question that arises in my mind, as if the book itself were speaking to me. Should I trust its prophecies?

recipes.label: Goal: The Traitor's Grave
recipes.startdescription: I have no interest in the lineage of this body of mine—but there must be a reason behind the deliberate concealment here: perhaps some hidden interest, or perhaps a certain truth.

recipes.label: Legacy of the Red Rose
recipes.startdescription: It is widely believed that the children of the Red Rose have all turned to bleached bones in the calamity. This claim is not entirely accurate—for the few bodies before my eyes are clearly quite well‑preserved. In the coffin of one among them lies a conspicuous hidden compartment, concealing a long and heavy weapon.

recipes.label: Goal: The Collapsed Dock
recipes.startdescription: As far as I know, my ally isn't fragile, nor does he have a habit of oversleeping—the fact that he hasn't managed to break free yet must mean he's run into some trouble down there. I should go and see what it is.

recipes.label: A Little White Lie
recipes.startdescription:
'Wickel!!!' Inside the collapsed dock, just as I ignored Fissifer's shouts and removed the excess parts, his roar nearly flung my physical form off its feet. 'I won't forget you left me here, with those damned imbeciles,' he hissed through clenched teeth. 'Your blasted promise had better still hold.'

'Oh, it does,' I replied at once. 'And I still have the power to make sure it's fulfilled.' That was, of course, a lie—but there's no harm in aiming high.

recipes.label: Goal: Lethe's Hideout
recipes.startdescription: Their hideout was neither hidden nor low-key—these days, you really have to deal with every bit of trouble yourself.

recipes.label: Back to Its Owner
recipes.startdescription: Mere mortals cannot possibly alter my creation; even after all this time, its structure remains as intact as ever. Moreover, there are still resources left in their stronghold.

recipes.label: Goal: Ruined Shelter
recipes.startdescription: Rummaging through a mess filled with the stench of copper is scarcely a dignified task. Best to finish this quickly.

recipes.label: An Unexpected Gain
recipes.startdescription: Though I've never held much fondness for Hokobald, I must admit that what lies before me is a rare and exquisite work; leaving it tucked away in some hidden nook would be a true waste. I fashioned for it a light-tight, heat‑resistant container—so large that it could only be dragged away—and did not glance back at the room heavy with the odor of copper and filth.

recipes.label: Goal: Breeze Collection
recipes.startdescription: Searching within dust-shrouded display cabinets and long corridors—until I find my target, or until my target finds me first.

recipes.label: Bright, Yet Not as Before
recipes.startdescription: I shattered the guardianship of this unusual thing, then elevated it with my power—and so it understood, completely abandoning its resistance to me. Any being with wisdom knows to yield to the stronger to ensure survival, however ancient it may be, however glorious it once was.

recipes.label: Goal: Sealed Chapel
recipes.startdescription: The situation has become complicated. I don't know who my friend is hiding from, but I must find him before they do if I'm to get answers.

recipes.label: A Belated Meeting
recipes.startdescription: 'As you know, even organisations dedicated to the same Hour are not always united, to say nothing of the Solar Church which admits varying beliefs. Tensions are high, and I have irreconcilable differences with many of my colleagues, which is why I was forced to hide.' The priest takes me warmly by the hand, making no effort to conceal his radiant nature. 'My view? I've always known that you would lead us to the right History … and here you are. Please let me bear witness to your journey.'

recipes.label: Goal: The Forgotten Temple
recipes.startdescription: A familiar yet repulsive aura grows ever stronger – a site sacred to the Forge? Or a place where she had worked? Either way, it seems I did not find this place by accident.

recipes.label: The Source of Change
recipes.startdescription: I swallow the fire born of the Forge's heart, and with a great power of remaking, bend it to my will. I have been permanently changed – I have mastered the power to reshape my very essence, which will be the first of many great alterations.

recipes.label: The Heart's Spark
recipes.startdescription: With much effort, I subjugated the fire born of the Forge's heart. With its power, I am able to more freely engage in the work of creation and transformation.

recipes.label: Goal: Conflicts on the Bounds
recipes.startdescription: This is an opportunity to weaken my enemy further, and to win over new allies in the process.

recipes.label: A Resounding Victory
recipes.startdescription: Under our coordinated offensive, the forces of the Triple Knot were completely routed and can no longer support their immortal allies. As a result, the commander of the other force has extended a friendly invitation to me.

recipes.label: Goal: Tomb of the Obdurant
recipes.startdescription: An unusual chill lingers in this ancient and solemn place… the mysteries of patience could help me obtain what I seek.

recipes.label: The Final Creation
recipes.startdescription: Opening the heavy, cast-iron coffin, a thick stench of death assailed my senses – not from the corpse within, but from an unusually shaped weapon. Soldiers' belongings were also placed around the weapon – it's unclear whether these were intended as offerings or wards.

recipes.label: Goal: The Monastery of the Fifth Cup
recipes.startdescription: Unfortunately, I cannot simply walk in there. I need to evade detection as much as possible, and if necessary, break through any defences that obstruct me… and of course, resisting the pervasive and enticing aroma of wine will also be a huge challenge.

recipes.label: The Red Flower's Promise
recipes.startdescription: 'Ah, yes. The Mare is indeed interested in this: your Sun is fearsomely formidable, but now dusk has fallen, which means night is not far off… Seeing as you've been quite well-behaved, we have a deal. Oh, and here's something for you – cheers.'

recipes.label: A Cold Welcome
recipes.startdescription: 'All right, put away your tricks, little candle.' The Name bursts into raucous laughter. 'You can't fool Auntie. We can't help you any further – besides a little cheap wine. Cheers.'

recipes.label: Goal: Forest of the Wolves
recipes.startdescription: The wolf pack slips silently through the dappled shade of the forest, their deep green eyes watching us discreetly. Deep within the cold, dark forest, the fallen guardian awaits.

recipes.label: The Call of Oblivion
recipes.startdescription:
'…. but I have seen your true nature.' After a long silence, the immortal speaks.

'You will bring pain, sorrow and unimaginable destruction to this world – so save your breath, and embrace that fate: when this world burns because of you, I too shall find my solace.' With that, she rose from the encircling wolf pack and silently followed me out of the forest.

recipes.label: Goal: Perfumer Studio
recipes.startdescription: My friend has clearly gone to excessive lengths to seclude herself. She'd better have a good reason for all this unnecessary trouble.

recipes.label: Shared Interests
recipes.startdescription: 'It really didn't have to be this troublesome, but I'm sick of the Soviets constantly snooping around.' The rose-witch yawns lazily, as if the topic had bored here. 'But back to business – how's your great work coming along? I was thinking, it's about time I did something that would uplift my spirits.'

recipes.label: Goal: Crossrow
recipes.startdescription: The haunting melody slowly converges and harmonises with the tune that I remember. Breaking through the dark foliage and tangled underbrush, I've finally found what I sought.

recipes.label: The Fire Yet to Come
recipes.startdescription: 'So it shall be.' After finishing, her calm expression changes to one I can't quite make out … pity? 'When the moment arrives, may you achieve your aspiration.'

recipes.label: Change Has Come
recipes.startdescription: 'Make good use of this secret and carve a path upward. This could be an opportunity to change everything. I've placed my bet, and whether that bet was wise or foolish … depends entirely on you.'

recipes.label: Waiting for the End
recipes.startdescription: 'So it shall be.' After finishing, her calm expression changes to one I can't quite make out … pity? 'When the moment arrives, may you achieve your aspiration.'

recipes.label: Goal: Hush House
recipes.startdescription: I had previously caused severe damage to Hush House out of frustration and a desire for revenge. I fear that many of the countermeasures taken against me remain effective to this day – the most serious of which is undoubtedly the lingering hostility of its guardian. Even after I overcome the various obstacles, I will still need to decipher the mystery left to me by Hush House's administrator.

recipes.label: Knowledge is Power
recipes.startdescription: I have grasped a truth powerful enough to change History. It's time to set out and continue my work.

recipes.label: Knowledge is Power
recipes.startdescription: I have grasped a truth powerful enough to change History. It's time to set out and continue my work.

recipes.label: Knowledge is Power
recipes.startdescription: I have grasped a truth powerful enough to change History. It's time to set out and continue my work.

recipes.label: Goal: Path to the Lake
recipes.startdescription: At last, the Meniscate's enigmatic illusions have been dispelled, but her Messengers have put up a last ditch effort to obstruct me. It is time I make them pay the price.

recipes.label: Mercury's Light
recipes.startdescription: A lithe yet balanced radiance envelops me, like a mirror, like mercury – by absorbing this fragment of the Meniscate, I have become bright and more perfect.

recipes.label: Goal: Orchard of Lights
recipes.startdescription: Each fruit in the Orchard of Lights glows like a sunset; the roots of the trees are shaped for peaceful rest; the mist soothes the heart. Alas, I am not here to sightsee – to be granted an audience with that Hour of beautiful endings, I must first evade the Names wandering the Orchard.

recipes.label: A Crown Forged of Cold
recipes.startdescription: The icy brilliance intensifies, and my agony is greater than before. Yet his intent is not to end me, but a twisted and cruel…. gift. The relentless cold solidifies and takes shape, becoming a shattered crown. Until I embrace my fate, the solace of an end will be ever more distant for me.

recipes.label: Not Now
recipes.startdescription:
I've already moving towards another point of interest.

[You cannot conduct any more expeditions.]

recipes.label: 正在抽取阻碍......
recipes.comments: 根据进度数量抽取不同的阻碍。

recipes.label: 阻碍判定器
recipes.comments: 这一配方链接着所有在副本内将会出现的阻碍。

recipes.label: Narrow Escape
recipes.startdescription:
This obstacle should have left me stranded—but today, fortune smiles on me.

[Whether prepared or not, you always have a slight chance to pass an otherwise insurmountable obstacle.]

recipes.label: Press On
recipes.startdescription: I have overcome this obstacle, but more still lies ahead.

recipes.label: Failed!
recipes.startdescription: I failed to overcome the obstacles encountered during the exploration! The resources invested earlier will be wasted, and this action will leave a clear trace—

recipes.label: Exploration Stalled
recipes.startdescription:
I must attempt again soon—lingering too long will draw unwanted attention.

[This has a high chance of leaving Traces.]

recipes.comments: 这一配方链接着所有副本的结束文本。

recipes.label: Obstacle: Secrecy?
recipes.startdescription:
This is a covert operation. I need to create a diversion as cover, or I must exercise patience.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Secrecy: Misguidance
recipes.startdescription: I have left credible misdirection elsewhere; no one will know I was ever here.

recipes.label: Secrecy: Patience
recipes.startdescription: Most traces can be avoided with patience, but patience is a rare virtue.

recipes.label: Obstacle: A Sealed Door
recipes.startdescription:
A sturdy door stands here. I could summon the power to open it wide, or simply melt it away entirely.
[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: A Sealed Door: Melted
recipes.startdescription: No matter what power once protected it, it will ultimately be reduced to a heap of molten slag and useless stone.

recipes.label: A Sealed Door: Opened
recipes.startdescription: All doors imply the intention to be opened; we only need to find the right key.

recipes.label: Obstacle: An Uncertain Location?
recipes.startdescription:
Before taking the next step, I need to pinpoint the target's exact location. I require the aid of illumination, or simply a key.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Locating: Illumination
recipes.startdescription: The right path is clearly revealed under the light. It is time to move forward.

recipes.label: Locating: Key
recipes.startdescription: A suitable key will lead us through the right door.

recipes.label: Obstacle: Cultists
recipes.startdescription:
I have many options: tear them apart with force, deceive them with trickery, or shatter their minds in blinding light.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Cultists: Crushed
recipes.startdescription: They fell like harvested wheat, their remains crushed to dust by overwhelming force. They never stood a chance.

recipes.label: Cultists: Gone Mad
recipes.startdescription: A sight no mortal could endure seized their minds—and it would be the only sight they would ever see again. There is no need to waste more time here.

recipes.label: Cultists: Deceived
recipes.startdescription: A simple trick — they'll never know I was here.

recipes.label: Obstacle: Ruins
recipes.startdescription:
Vast ruins lie strewn across the path I must travel. I need the power of reforging, or the power of opening, to clear the way.
[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Ruins: Melted
recipes.startdescription: Bothersome obstacles are melted, broken down, and swept from the path. There will be no more trouble.

recipes.label: Ruins: Opened
recipes.startdescription: The power of opening will ensure my path is safe and smooth. I shall pass through unhindered.

recipes.label: Obstacle: A Procedure?
recipes.startdescription:
The shell of Fissifer was already in a state of poor maintenance, and lately it was heavily crushed without any preparation—now, the only way to get him moving again is to give up some of his components. I need either sharp tools or reforging power to get the job done.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: A Procedure: Reforge
recipes.startdescription: 'Ouch! You son of a—'

recipes.label: A Procedure: Sharp
recipes.startdescription: 'Oh! Damn it!'

recipes.label: Obstacle: Outer-Things?
recipes.startdescription:
An invader that has breached the skin of the world, its form here is twisted and grotesque. I need force, or the power that governs sealing and opening.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Outer-Things: Sharp
recipes.startdescription: Although it is twisted and terrifying in form, it is indeed a living being—and with absolute force, any living thing can be killed.

recipes.label: Outer-Things: Banishing
recipes.startdescription: It truly exists here, but it does not belong to this realm. A door opened in reverse can send it back to where it truly belongs.

recipes.label: Outer-Things: End
recipes.startdescription: This being shares the weaknesses of its close kin. In wordless solemnity, its activity shall meet its end.

recipes.label: Obstacle: Drowning Curse?
recipes.startdescription:
A salty, damp scent swirls in the air ahead—only the powers of ceaselessness and devouring can overcome its corruption.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Drowning Curse: Ceaselessness
recipes.startdescription: Even under crushing weight, stifled into suffocation, and lashed by countless tides — the unceasing heart still dances, unyielding as ever.

recipes.label: Drowning Curse: Devoured
recipes.startdescription: Like the Grail draining the Tide, it devours the power of curses. Even as the weight loosens and the tide recedes, it still thirsts for more.

recipes.label: Obstacle: THE ULTIMATE DEFENSE
recipes.startdescription:
This—this is impossible. Even if he truly possesses the talent he boasts of, there is no way he could have established such powerful protection.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration...?]

recipes.label: THE ULTIMATE DEFENSE: No Response?
recipes.startdescription: This power should be more than enough to contend with the strongest defenses, yet the spells that compose it seem to have no reaction at all?

recipes.label: THE ULTIMATE DEFENSE: No Response?
recipes.startdescription: This power should be more than enough to contend with the strongest defenses, yet the spells that compose it seem to have no reaction at all?

recipes.label: THE ULTIMATE DEFENSE: No Response?
recipes.startdescription: This power should be more than enough to contend with the strongest defenses, yet the spells that compose it seem to have no reaction at all?

recipes.label: THE ULTIMATE DEFENSE: Not Affected?
recipes.startdescription: Perhaps a previous intruder had disrupted its operation, or it never possessed genuine defensive capabilities from the start. I passed through safely, completely unimpeded.

recipes.label: Obstacle: A Great Seal
recipes.startdescription:
This item holds extra potency against Longs and other, mightier beings—yet my task remains unchanged in essence.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: A Great Seal: Dismantled
recipes.startdescription: The searing red heat will break down and nullify the seal's power.

recipes.label: A Great Seal: Opened
recipes.startdescription: Some keys cannot be refused, no matter how fiercely the seal tries to repel them.

recipes.label: Obstacle: Furnace Spark
recipes.startdescription:
It is widely believed that, in that war that spanned the entirety of Europe, the Forge stood alone against an alliance of Hours and forced them to yield. However, it seems she had paid a small price to effect that compromise – which was to discard part of her heart.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Furnace Spark: Reforged
recipes.startdescription: However, the Hours could not have imagined that the Forge, who ends what will not change, was masterful enough to change even herself. Though the reforging split away a spark of her shining flame, she remains formidable as ever. And by a similar method, I too can harness this spark for myself.

recipes.label: Furnace Spark: Ceaselessness
recipes.startdescription: However, the Hours could not have imagined that the strength of the Forge, who remakes with fire, would be so inexorably ceaseless. Though the reforging split away fire from her heart, she could recover enough of her shaping power. And by a similar method, I too can harness this spark for myself.

recipes.label: Obstacle: Pyric Theoplasma
recipes.startdescription:
An invisible incandescence lingers here. I will not be able to pass so easily.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Pyric Theoplasma: A Greater Power
recipes.startdescription: As the Forge eclipsed the Flint, so too does my power overwhelm this lingering influence.

recipes.label: Pyric Theoplasma: Extinguished
recipes.startdescription: The power of silence and ending will extinguish this formless inferno.

recipes.label: Obstacle: Actinic Theoplasma
recipes.startdescription:
A prickly brightness glows here. I will not be able to pass so easily.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Actinic Theoplasma: A Greater Power
recipes.startdescription: As the Glory overshadows the light in the Wood before its darkening, so too does my power overwhelm this lingering influence.

recipes.label: Actinic Theoplasma: Changed
recipes.startdescription: The power of flame and reshaping will expel this loathsome radiance.

recipes.label: Obstacle: Chionic Theoplasma
recipes.startdescription:
A sinister cold lingers here. I will not be able to pass so easily.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Chionic Theoplasma: A Greater Power
recipes.startdescription: As the Chiliarch drove out the Nowhere-Hour Snow, so too does my power overwhelm this lingering influence.

recipes.label: Chionic Theoplasma: Ceaselessness
recipes.startdescription: The beat of the Drum Unceasing will dispel this bitter, otherworldly cold.

recipes.label: Obstacle: A Puzzling Conundrum
recipes.startdescription:
The problem before me cannot be solved through ordinary reasoning. I must take an unconventional approach, or draw on more esoteric knowledge.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: A Puzzling Conundrum: Inspiration
recipes.startdescription: Where reason is of no avail, inspiration will pull together seemingly unrelated fragments.

recipes.label: A Puzzling Conundrum: Secrets
recipes.startdescription: Knowledge drawn from another History may be enough to resolve this.

recipes.label: Try to Persuade Aunt Mopsy?
recipes.startdescription:
'I'm happy that you still remember me, dear. If you had entered in a more appropriate manner, I'd have been happier still.'

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Lies and Threats
recipes.startdescription: 'Oh? I hadn't considered that.'

recipes.label: The Temptation of Profit
recipes.startdescription: 'Go on – I'm intrigued.'

recipes.label: Obstacle: The Wood
recipes.startdescription:
The path forward is hidden away in a secluded corner of the Wood. I must use my power to find my way.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: The Wood: Inspiration
recipes.startdescription: I move forward guided by my instinct. The shadows in the Wood dance and shift, but I always manage to find my bearing.

recipes.label: The Wood: Guidance
recipes.startdescription: Through the power of opening, we may find passage. With its guidance, I pass through the ever-changing Wood.

recipes.label: Try to Persuade…?
recipes.startdescription:
'……'

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Lies and Deception
recipes.startdescription: 'Even the deepest wounds can be healed. Come closer, and I will show you the right path…'

recipes.label: The Temptation of an Ending
recipes.startdescription: 'Even suffering itself can be ended. Come closer, and you will know more…'

recipes.label: Obstacle: Adepts
recipes.startdescription:
Although still mortal, true adepts can cause much more trouble than the superficial pretences of mere cultists. I must answer their skill with my own.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Adepts: Changed
recipes.startdescription: Even with all the powers of protection they can call upon, their mortal bodies will indubitably be burned to ashes.

recipes.label: Adepts: Driven Mad
recipes.startdescription: Even with all the powers of protection they can call upon, their mortal minds will indubitably be twisted and destroyed.

recipes.label: Adepts: Ended
recipes.startdescription: Even with all the powers of protection they can call upon, their mortal lives will indubitably be ended.

recipes.label: Obstacle: A Frantic Struggle
recipes.startdescription:
The decisive moment has come. What strategy will help us secure victory?

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: A Frantic Struggle: Overwhelming Force
recipes.startdescription: We have an overwhelming advantage, and can win through sheer force alone.

recipes.label: A Frantic Struggle: The Changing Blade
recipes.startdescription: We will tear through the enemy's lines with terrifying strength.

recipes.label: A Frantic Struggle: The Changing Blade
recipes.startdescription: We will tear through the enemy's lines with terrifying strength.

recipes.label: A Frantic Struggle: The Ending Blade
recipes.startdescription: We will draw on the wisdom of patience and cunning to steadily expand on our successes.

recipes.label: A Frantic Struggle: The Ending Blade
recipes.startdescription: We will draw on the wisdom of patience and cunning to steadily expand on our successes.

recipes.label: State Your Purpose?
recipes.startdescription:
'No, I don't need help. The situation is tolerable, but I won't let them overstep any further.' 

[Use your Desire to advance.]

recipes.label: State Your Purpose
recipes.startdescription: 'It seems failure hasn't dampened your spirit.' For a moment, a faint smile flickers across her face. 'Perhaps you truly can manifest the coming of the Chandler before their appointed time. In that case, I will give you the flame that you need……'

recipes.label: State Your Purpose
recipes.startdescription: 'I never imagined you would return to his path in this way… yet my lord has always looked forward to this day. It seems he was one step ahead of me after all. There is another who has the same expectations of you. When all has been made ready, you must go there in person……'

recipes.label: State Your Purpose
recipes.startdescription: 'I never dared to believe that you would come this far – but perhaps this is for the best, for both of us. Now listen carefully: there is a fundamental flaw in the fabric of all things……'

recipes.label: Understand a History-Ending Truth?
recipes.startdescription:
This is a truth powerful enough to sway any History. It will not be easy to fully comprehend its essence.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Understand: Revelation
recipes.startdescription: Mercy is found only in shadow, and the greatest insights are never compassionate.

recipes.label: Understand: History
recipes.startdescription: If we seek to change History, we must first understand its nature.

recipes.label: Obstacle: The Moon's Wound
recipes.startdescription:
A powerful energy radiates from the Moon's wound. I must find some way to channel it. 

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: The Moon's Wound: Change
recipes.startdescription: What has been broken can be reforged. Through the arts of shaping, I will transform the Meniscate's wound into power I can use.

recipes.label: The Moon's Wound: Guidance
recipes.startdescription: All wounds are doors – and it is through such doors that we may channel all forms of power.

recipes.label: An Audience with a Chilly Power of Ending?
recipes.startdescription: The icy brilliance of the Sun-in-Rags pierces my flesh and blood, and burns deep to my very soul. He is silent: his will needs no words to be conveyed. Do I truly understand what it means to end? To sacrifice? That this path is also the end of my destiny……?

recipes.label: An Audience with a Chilly Power of Ending
recipes.startdescription: I call upon that resolve deep within me -– that final, unchanging will, more ruthless than even his icy brilliance -–
